title: Answer an open adj record from the Questions tab: pick an option, type the reason, confirm

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-25: the Questions tab (S27) shows open adj records read-only; the owner wants to answer them in the TUI. adj decide is owner-only for agents (AGENTS.md); the TUI is the owner's tool, so adj 159 (ui.answer-adj) records that the TUI may run it after a confirm. Decisions of 2026-10-25: pick an option, type the reason, confirm the exact command, --by from the project's git user.name. S28 (engine answer toggle that files an adj ask and decide) is separate and does not add this path.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go`: a Decide(ctx, root, id, option, why, by) write wrapper running `adj decide ID OPTION --why TEXT --by NAME --root DIR`, plus a free-text form `adj decide ID --text TEXT --why TEXT`; errors returned verbatim.
- `internal/daemon/wire.go`, `handlers.go`, `client.go`: a write method `adj.decide` (proposed; params project, id, option or text, why, by) and its client call; it refuses an unknown project or a record that is not open.
- `internal/tui/live.go`, `daemon.go` and the fakes: AdjDecide.
- `internal/tui/questions.go` and `decisions.go` (record pane): digit keys pick an option, `t` picks free text, a textField asks the reason (required), then the confirm bar shows the exact `adj decide ID OPTION --why TEXT` (Enter is No, decision 98); y calls the daemon; the record leaves Questions after the refresh; errors show verbatim.
- `internal/tui/keys.go`, `view.go` (hint), `internal/tui/field.go` (textField).
- Tests beside each, `testdata/golden/questions-answer-*.txt`, `docs/dashboard.md` and `docs/design.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestAdjDecideRunsTheExactCommand (adjcli, fake adj): argv is decide ID OPTION --why TEXT --by NAME --root DIR; free text uses --text.
- TestAdjDecideSurfacesTheToolErrorVerbatim.
- TestDaemonAdjDecideRefusesAnUnknownProjectOrAClosedRecord.
- TestQuestionAnswerPicksAnOptionAsksTheReasonThenConfirms: digit picks, textField asks, an empty reason is refused with no call, the confirm bar shows the exact command, Enter, n and esc call nothing, y calls once.
- TestQuestionAnswerByIsTheGitUserName: --by is the project's git user.name, else $ADJ_DECIDED_BY, else omitted.
- TestAnsweredRecordLeavesTheQuestionsList after the refresh.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Check `adj check ui.answer-adj`; stop if it is not decided (adj 159). 2. Tests first. 3. adjcli.Decide and the daemon method. 4. The TUI flow in the record pane. 5. Docs, then go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Not in this slice: adj reject, withdraw or supersede from the TUI; S28.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/adjcli ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] On a test project with one open adj question, the owner answers it from the Questions tab and finds the record decided with the typed reason and their name.
